title: Resolve meaning before formal authoring
description: A clinical source and examples are refined into an explicit specification reviewed by clinical and terminology experts before formal FHIR/CQL authoring.

nodes.label: Source meaning
nodes.body: Recommendation, evidence, clinical examples and data assumptions

nodes.label: Explicit specification
nodes.body: Concepts, criteria, timing, exceptions and expected results; clinical review

nodes.label: Formal artifacts
nodes.body: FHIR profiles and terminology; Library/CQL; PlanDefinition / ActivityDefinition

notes.text: Record unresolved questions and mapping qualifications. Tools do not decide clinical meaning.
Legend: blue = clinical/specification work; green = formal artifacts. Arrows = reviewed handoffs.
